title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Task completed successfully. Analysis of flame speed vs chamber pressure data (68 data points) was performed using linear, power law, and exponential decay models. The exponential decay model provided the best fit (R² = 0.488). Deliverables: (1) Analysis code in code/analyze_flame_pressure.py, (2) Two figures in report/images/ (flame_pressure_analysis.png, correlation_plot.png), (3) Comprehensive research report in report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and conclusions.
